papers.title: Honeycomb-Surfels: Compact Hexagonal Primitives for Efficient Scene Rendering and Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Novel view synthesis and 3D reconstruction have advanced rapidly with radiance fields and splatting, yet their memory and computational demands limit their use in resource-constrained settings. We introduce Hexels: novel planar hexagonal surface elements with a first-order spatial color field for efficient 3D scene and 2D image representation. Hexels exploit locally planar regions with smoothly varying appearance using fewer, larger primitives. Their hexagonal support provides an area- and boundary-efficient domain, while the local color field captures appearance variation within each primitive. Across 34 scenes, Hexels improve PSNR over memory-matched 2DGS by 4.53-7.38 dB across datasets while requiring lower training VRAM. We further ablate Hexels by showing that per primitive, Hexels outperform 2DGS by upto 4.74 dB while using lower training VRAM and having 2.31 times faster FPS. Even in unconstrained settings, Hexels offers complementary quality-memory trade-offs. For efficient 3D surface reconstruction, Hexels reduce error by 28.9% compared with memory-matched 2DGS across 15 DTU scans. On 6 Tanks and Temples surface scenes, Hexels achieves the highest mean F1 among compared methods (34.38%, versus 31.72% for 2DGS). We further also show that Hexels, as a general primitive, improves 2D image representation over Image-GS. Hexels push the Pareto frontier on the quality-efficiency trade-off of surface-aligned primitives.
papers.summary_zh: 辐射场与splatting虽推动新视角合成和3D重建，但其内存与计算需求限制了资源受限场景的应用。作者提出Hexels——带一阶空间颜色场的平面六边形表面元素，利用局部平面区域和少而大的图元高效表示3D场景与2D图像。在34个场景上，Hexels较内存匹配的2DGS提升PSNR 4.53-7.38 dB且训练显存更低，DTU重建误差降低28.9%，推进了质量-效率的帕累托前沿。
papers.summary_en: Radiance fields and splatting have advanced novel view synthesis and 3D reconstruction, but their memory and compute demands limit use in resource-constrained settings. We introduce Hexels, planar hexagonal surface elements with a first-order spatial color field that exploit locally planar regions with smoothly varying appearance using fewer, larger primitives. Across 34 scenes, Hexels improve PSNR over memory-matched 2DGS by 4.53-7.38 dB with lower training VRAM, reduce DTU reconstruction error by 28.9%, and push the Pareto frontier of the quality-efficiency trade-off for surface-aligned primitives.
highlights_zh: 六边形图元+一阶颜色场
PSNR超2DGS达7.38dB
高效渲染与表面重建

papers.title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strengthens it through reinforcement learning with world imagination. ThinkWorld represents each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD), a sequence of discrete motion tokens that captures the intermediate dynamics connecting the current world to a future state and serves as a common action representation across embodiments. We first initialize CoD with action-labeled demonstrations, then predict the future induced by each CoD and reinforce those whose predictions better match the observed outcome. This enables videos without action annotations to provide direct supervision from observed state transitions, allowing human and robot experience to refine the same reasoning space. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.
papers.summary_zh: VLA模型在机器人操作上进展显著，但泛化受限于动作标注演示的多样性与覆盖度，而人类视频虽经验丰富却面临可扩展数据与显式动作 grounding 的权衡。ThinkWorld将动作思维表示为Chain-of-Dynamics（离散运动token序列），先用动作标注演示初始化，再通过预测未来并与观测结果匹配来强化推理，使无动作标注视频也能提供监督。仿真与真机实验验证了有效的人到机器人迁移及对未见任务和环境的强泛化能力。
papers.summary_en: VLA models have advanced in robotic manipulation but generalize poorly due to limited diversity and coverage of action-labeled demonstrations, while learning from human videos faces a trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. ThinkWorld represents each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics, a sequence of discrete motion tokens capturing intermediate dynamics toward a future state, initialized from action-labeled demonstrations and reinforced by predicting futures that better match observed outcomes, enabling unlabeled videos to supervise the same reasoning space. Experiments in simulation and on real robots show effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.
highlights_zh: 以Chain-of-Dynamics统一跨具身动作表示
仿真与真机均实现有效人到机器人迁移
可泛化至未见任务，但依赖预测质量

papers.title: When Should We Intervene at Test Time?
papers.abstract: Test-time adaptation helps a deployed model respond to changing inputs, but the same intervention can rescue one batch and damage the next. Updating normalization statistics, for example, can improve corrupted images yet fail when a batch contains mostly one class. Average accuracy hides these failures and cannot tell a model when to use an intervention. Target labels can guide this decision, but they are scarce and some choices are already clear. We introduce PORTAL, a controller that chooses when to deploy an intervention, which inputs to label, and when to stop querying. Each available prediction rule is a candidate, and its predictions are fixed before current feedback arrives. Every acquired label therefore evaluates all candidates on the same input. PORTAL combines these shared comparisons and directs queries toward candidates that can still overtake the current leader. It stops when the remaining labels cannot change the choice or when the possible accuracy gain no longer justifies another query. Our analysis links the required feedback to accuracy gaps and shared mistakes, explaining why some choices need much less evidence. Experiments show that this control turns an intervention that loses accuracy overall into a useful choice on selected batches. It prevents severe failures caused by changes in arrival order and preserves gains across complete corruption streams. When a fixed rule already works well, PORTAL uses little feedback to retain its performance. Periodic label checks reveal when past evidence needs refreshing and help the controller recover as conditions change. The acquired labels also train stronger candidates for future batches, and selection brings nearly all of their accuracy gains into deployment. The same feedback therefore improves both the choice made now and the predictions available to later batches.
papers.summary_zh: 测试时适应中，同一干预（如更新归一化统计）可能拯救一个批次却损害另一个批次，平均准确率掩盖了这些失败且无法指导模型何时使用干预。作者提出PORTAL控制器，在反馈到来前固定各候选预测规则的预测，利用每个获取的标签对全部候选进行共享比较，将查询导向仍可能反超当前领先者的候选，并在剩余标签无法改变选择或收益不足时停止查询。实验表明该控制能将整体上损失准确率的干预转变为选定批次上的有用选择，防止到达顺序变化导致的严重失败，并在固定规则已有效时以少量反馈保持性能。
papers.summary_en: In test-time adaptation, the same intervention (e.g., updating normalization statistics) can rescue one batch but damage another, and average accuracy hides these failures while giving no signal for when to intervene. The authors introduce PORTAL, a controller that fixes each candidate prediction rule's predictions before feedback arrives, uses every acquired label to compare all candidates on the same input, directs queries toward candidates that can still overtake the current leader, and stops when remaining labels cannot change the choice or the possible gain no longer justifies another query. Experiments show this control turns an overall accuracy-losing intervention into a useful choice on selected batches, prevents severe failures from arrival-order changes, preserves gains across corruption streams, and uses little feedback when a fixed rule already works well.
highlights_zh: 共享标签比较所有候选并定向查询
干预由整体损失转为选定批次增益
需标签反馈，条件变化时需刷新证据

papers.title: Heads of Security: Learned Attention Gates Improve Prompt Injection Robustness
papers.abstract: We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates. HoS learns how each head should redistribute attention between trusted and untrusted tokens, enabling models to reason over untrusted content without following injected instructions. We evaluate HoS on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and GPT-OSS-20B. We compare it against SecAlign++, a state-of-the-art finetuning-based defense, and ASIDE, a defense that, like ours, builds instruction-data separation into the model architecture. We show that HoS offers greater robustness to adaptive attacks, better performance on standard utility benchmarks, and matches top performance on standard agentic prompt injection benchmarks. More specifically, the black-box RL-Hammer attack reaches 97% ASR against GPT-OSS-20B and 85% against SecAlign, but only 10% against HoS. Claudini, a state-of-the-art white-box attack, strengthened against HoS through autoresearch, requires 3 times more FLOPs to reach the same ASR on HoS as it does on GPT-OSS-20B or SecAlign. HoS preserves base-model utility across standard multiple-choice benchmarks and prompting setups, whereas SecAlign and ASIDE degrade in few-shot settings. On agentic benchmarks with static attacks, HoS and SecAlign perform similarly and substantially improve the security-utility trade-off over the base model. ASIDE struggles with tool use, achieving only 10% utility. These results show that prompt injection robustness can be achieved and improved through targeted attention interventions.
papers.summary_zh: 提示注入攻击要求模型区分可信指令与不可信数据，现有防御在自适应攻击下鲁棒性不足。本文提出Heads of Security（HoS），通过少量可学习的逐头注意力门控实现指令-数据分离，让每个注意力头学会在可信与不可信token间重新分配注意力。在Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct和GPT-OSS-20B上，HoS对RL-Hammer攻击的ASR仅10%（基线达85%-97%），且保持基座模型效用，表明针对性注意力干预可有效提升提示注入鲁棒性。
papers.summary_en: Prompt injection attacks require models to separate trusted instructions from untrusted data, yet existing defenses remain vulnerable to adaptive attacks. We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates, teaching each head how to redistribute attention between trusted and untrusted tokens. On Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and GPT-OSS-20B, HoS reduces RL-Hammer attack ASR to 10% (versus 85-97% for baselines) while preserving base-model utility, demonstrating that targeted attention interventions can achieve and improve prompt injection robustness.
highlights_zh: 逐头学习注意力门控实现指令数据分离
RL-Hammer攻击ASR仅10%，基线达85%+
保持基座效用，少样本下优于对比方法

papers.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments. Existing reflective prompt optimizers such as GEPA learn from failed rollouts, but agentic failures can also come from prompt weaknesses, harness limitations, stochastic execution, or noisy judges. We argue that such failures may not provide useful learning signal, and may even be harmful; and thus it is essential to curate which tasks are provided to the prompt optimizer for better performance. We introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the prompt optimizer to select which agent experiences should shape prompt optimization. In particular, GEPA-Curator consists of two components: task curation, which filters out tasks that are likely to provide noisy or unreliable learning signals, and prior success retrieval, which selectively retrieves past successful trajectories for a task and provides them as additional context to the prompt optimizer. We evaluate GEPA-Curator on GoBrowse, ALFWorld, AppWorld, and $τ$-bench, using both Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 5 as optimizer models. GEPA-Curator matches or exceeds the mean performance of both baselines, with gains of up to 20.7% over GEPA and 21.2% over ACE.
papers.summary_zh: 在多轮智能体任务中，GEPA等反思式提示优化器会从失败轨迹中学习，但智能体失败也可能源于提示缺陷、执行框架限制、随机执行或噪声评判，这些失败信号可能无用甚至有害。作者提出GEPA-Curator框架，通过任务筛选过滤掉可能提供噪声学习信号的任务，并通过先验成功检索为优化器提供相关历史成功轨迹作为额外上下文。在GoBrowse、ALFWorld、AppWorld和τ-bench上，使用Gemini 3.1 Pro和Claude Opus 5作为优化器模型，GEPA-Curator匹配或超过基线平均性能，相较GEPA最高提升20.7%，相较ACE最高提升21.2%。
papers.summary_en: In multi-turn agentic workloads, reflective prompt optimizers like GEPA learn from failed rollouts, but agentic failures can also stem from prompt weaknesses, harness limitations, stochastic execution, or noisy judges, making such failures potentially uninformative or even harmful as learning signals. The authors introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the prompt optimizer with task curation, which filters out tasks likely to yield noisy or unreliable learning signals, and prior success retrieval, which selectively retrieves past successful trajectories as additional context. Evaluated on GoBrowse, ALFWorld, AppWorld, and τ-bench with Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 5 as optimizer models, GEPA-Curator matches or exceeds baseline mean performance, with gains up to 20.7% over GEPA and 21.2% over ACE.
highlights_zh: 筛选任务并检索成功轨迹以净化学习信号
较GEPA提升20.7%，较ACE提升21.2%
提升智能体提示优化可靠性
highlights_en: Curates tasks and retrieves successful trajectories
Up to 20.7% over GEPA, 21.2% over ACE
Improves reliability of agent prompt optimization

papers.title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
papers.abstract: Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. In a world with altered physical laws, can large language models (LLMs) notice unexpected behavior, such as heavier objects falling more slowly, and discover the law through experiments without being told what to investigate? To evaluate this ability, we introduce LongChang, an automated framework that creates simulated worlds with altered physics, where one or more laws differ from ordinary physics. The evaluated LLMs act as explorers, manipulating objects and building tools to investigate their own questions without research tasks or hints about these laws. Separate LLM agents generate and review scenes, review tool designs, and evaluate reports for correctness and experimental support using the altered physical laws and exploration records. These records guide scene evolution for further exploration, allowing the full cycle to run without human intervention. Among 12 LLMs, GPT-6-Astra achieves a discovery rate of 16.7%, while the other 11 score 0%. The exploration records reveal uninvestigated anomalies and only partial identification of the altered physical laws.
papers.summary_zh: 科学发现常始于意外观察，但LLM能否在未被告知研究目标的情况下自主发现异常并揭示隐藏物理定律尚不清楚。作者提出LongChang自动化框架，构建物理定律被改变且无研究任务提示的模拟世界，让LLM作为探索者操控物体、设计工具，并由多个LLM智能体分别生成审查场景、审核工具设计、依据改变后的定律与探索记录评估报告正确性，形成无人干预的闭环。在12个LLM中，GPT-6-Astra发现率达16.7%，其余11个均为0%，探索记录显示大量异常未被调查、对改变定律仅部分识别，表明当前LLM自主科学发现能力仍很有限。
papers.summary_en: Scientific discovery often begins with unexpected observations, yet it remains unclear whether LLMs can notice anomalies and uncover hidden physical laws without being told what to investigate. The authors introduce LongChang, an automated framework that builds simulated worlds with altered physics, where LLMs act as explorers manipulating objects and building tools while separate LLM agents generate and review scenes, vet tool designs, and evaluate reports against the altered laws and exploration records in a fully autonomous loop. Among 12 LLMs, GPT-6-Astra reaches a 16.7% discovery rate while the other 11 score 0%, and exploration records reveal many uninvestigated anomalies and only partial identification of the altered laws, highlighting the limited autonomous discovery ability of current LLMs.
highlights_zh: 无提示自主探索隐藏物理定律的闭环框架
GPT-6-Astra发现率16.7%，其余11个模型均为0%
揭示LLM自主科学发现能力仍有限

papers.title: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
papers.abstract: Discrete visual tokens represent vision in a discrete form analogous to language, offering a native interface for multimodal modeling under a shared next-token prediction objective. However, quantization error is widely assumed to cause unavoidable semantic loss, fundamentally limiting the semantic fidelity of discrete visual tokens and positioning continuous visual representations as an intrinsic upper bound. Using multimodal understanding as a proxy for semantic fidelity, we revisit this assumption and find quantization error unreliable, as discrete representations with substantially larger errors can achieve better understanding. Instead, the effective bit budget of discrete indices emerges as a key determinant of downstream performance. However, existing quantizers eventually saturate as additional codebooks contribute progressively less semantic information. As one approach to alleviating this saturation, we introduce Factorized Vector Quantization, which quantizes complementary, fixed-dimensional views of the visual feature with symmetric parallel codebooks. It continues to improve at larger bit budgets, ultimately matching continuous visual representations in multimodal understanding. Trained on industrial-scale multimodal data, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance among discrete-representation models, outperforming UniAR and Emu3-Chat by 22.8% and 59.2%, respectively, on a nine-metric average. To our knowledge, it is also the first discrete-representation model competitive with strong continuous-representation models such as Qwen3-VL, including on fine-grained OCR tasks. We further identify the key principles and a practical recipe enabling this competitiveness. These results and insights support the potential of discrete visual representations to underpin large-scale native multimodal foundation models. Code and models are available at https://github.com/hustvl/FVQ
papers.summary_zh: 离散视觉token因量化误差被认为存在不可避免的语义损失，其语义保真度被认为不如连续视觉表示。作者发现量化误差并非可靠指标，有效比特预算才是关键，并提出因子化向量量化（FVQ），用对称并行码本量化互补的固定维度视图以缓解码本饱和。在工业级多模态数据上训练后，该模型在九项指标均值上分别超越UniAR和Emu3-Chat 22.8%和59.2%，首次使离散表示模型在细粒度OCR等任务上与Qwen3-VL等强连续表示模型相当。
papers.summary_en: Discrete visual tokens are widely assumed to suffer unavoidable semantic loss from quantization error, making continuous visual representations an intrinsic upper bound. The authors show that quantization error is an unreliable proxy and that the effective bit budget of discrete indices drives downstream performance, then introduce Factorized Vector Quantization (FVQ), which quantizes complementary fixed-dimensional views with symmetric parallel codebooks to alleviate codebook saturation. Trained on industrial-scale multimodal data, the model achieves state-of-the-art results among discrete-representation models, outperforming UniAR and Emu3-Chat by 22.8% and 59.2% on a nine-metric average and becoming the first discrete-representation model competitive with strong continuous models such as Qwen3-VL, including fine-grained OCR.
highlights_zh: 提出因子化向量量化FVQ缓解码本饱和
九指标均值超UniAR 22.8%、Emu3-Chat 59.2%
离散表示首次媲美强连续模型含OCR

papers.title: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Cross-View Temporal Object Correspondence
papers.abstract: Cross-view object correspondence identifies the same object across views. However, existing methods often rely on frame-wise matching or sequential tracking, which can propagate correspondence errors under appearance changes or occlusions. Therefore, we introduce cross-view temporal object correspondence, which requires preserving object identity across both views and time from a query mask. To address this, we propose XTrack, a unified framework which repurposes a pretrained video DiT with semantic and spatiotemporal priors for RGB-to-mask latent transport, jointly modeling cross-view matching and temporal tracking. However, naive video DiTs do not guarantee accurate cross-view grounding and often attend to semantically similar yet incorrect objects across views. Thus, we introduce focal cross-view attention alignment, hard negative conditioning, and local context crop strategies to ensure reliable grounding. Finally, beyond these architectural enhancements, we also tackle the lack of dense annotation by introducing a pseudo-label curation pipeline that converts sparse Ego-Exo4D annotations into dense supervision to enable effective video-level training. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of XTrack as a unified framework, ensuring robust temporal consistency and identity preservation.
papers.summary_zh: 跨视角物体对应需在视角与时间上保持物体身份，但现有逐帧匹配或序列跟踪方法在外观变化或遮挡下易传播对应错误。作者提出XTrack，复用预训练视频DiT的语义与时空先验进行RGB到掩码的潜空间传输，联合建模跨视角匹配与时间跟踪，并引入焦点跨视角注意力对齐、难负样本条件化和局部上下文裁剪策略，同时构建伪标签流程将稀疏Ego-Exo4D标注转为稠密监督。结果表明XTrack作为统一框架能有效保证时间一致性与身份保持，实现稳健的跨视角时序物体对应。
papers.summary_en: Cross-view object correspondence aims to identify the same object across views, but existing frame-wise matching or sequential tracking methods can propagate correspondence errors under appearance changes or occlusions. We propose XTrack, a unified framework that repurposes a pretrained video DiT with semantic and spatiotemporal priors for RGB-to-mask latent transport, jointly modeling cross-view matching and temporal tracking, enhanced by focal cross-view attention alignment, hard negative conditioning, and local context crop strategies, plus a pseudo-label curation pipeline that converts sparse Ego-Exo4D annotations into dense supervision. Results show XTrack effectively ensures robust temporal consistency and identity preservation as a unified framework for cross-view temporal object correspondence.
highlights_zh: 复用视频DiT统一跨视角匹配与时序跟踪
伪标签流程实现稀疏标注到稠密监督
适用于遮挡与外观变化场景，依赖标注质量

papers.title: Pushing Dexterity and Safety for In-Hand Object Pose Reaching That Works Remarkably Well
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation with multi-fingered hands is the next frontier of robotics, yet learned hand skills remain limited to simple grasps or basic repeated motions, such as rotating an object. As robots attempt more demanding in-hand maneuvers, safety, such as not dropping the object, becomes critical, yet it is rarely measured. We study in-hand object pose reaching, a task that demands diverse and difficult grasps: moving an object to almost any position and orientation within reach of the fingers, at any wrist orientation, through long sequences of consecutive goals. We present a recipe for training such policies for a LEAP hand in simulation without human data, built on a range of insights, from diverse resets and goals via generated grasp datasets to an adaptive friction curriculum. With careful system identification, the policies transfer zero-shot to the real hand, using either motion capture or a single wrist-mounted depth camera, and prove remarkably capable and robust. On top of the task policy, we add a learned residual safety filter with adjustable conservativeness, letting us tune the balance between performance and safety and greatly reduce object drops. In 13.3 hours of real-robot evaluation over 4,800 unseen goals across 4 objects and diverse wrist orientations, the state-based policy reaches 95.2% of goals within 2 cm and 0.4 rad, and the filter cuts its drops by 75% while still reaching 91.5% of goals. The policies can also spin a lightbulb held in an arbitrary pose, reach out-of-distribution goals, withstand fast arm motion and perturbations, and, needing only a wrist camera, serve as portable skills such as screwing in a lightbulb. We release the full recipe as a platform for studying performance, reliability, and safety in high-dimensional dexterous systems. Videos and more are available at https://ian-chuang.github.io/dexsafe/.
papers.summary_zh: 多指灵巧手操作是机器人前沿难题，但已学习的手部技能仍局限于简单抓取或重复动作，且安全性（如不掉落物体）很少被衡量。本文研究手内物体位姿到达任务，提出一套无需人类数据的仿真训练方案，涵盖多样化重置与目标生成、自适应摩擦课程和系统辨识，并加入可调保守度的学习残差安全过滤器。在LEAP手上零样本迁移到真实机器人，13.3小时4800个未见目标测试中基于状态的策略达到95.2%成功率，安全过滤器将掉落减少75%同时保持91.5%成功率，并展现出旋转灯泡、抗扰动等能力。
papers.summary_en: Dexterous manipulation with multi-fingered hands is a frontier of robotics, yet learned hand skills remain limited to simple grasps or basic repeated motions, and safety such as not dropping objects is rarely measured. This paper studies in-hand object pose reaching and presents a simulation training recipe for a LEAP hand without human data, combining diverse resets and goals from generated grasp datasets, an adaptive friction curriculum, careful system identification for zero-shot real transfer, and a learned residual safety filter with adjustable conservativeness. In 13.3 hours of real-robot evaluation over 4,800 unseen goals across 4 objects and diverse wrist orientations, the state-based policy reaches 95.2% of goals within 2 cm and 0.4 rad while the filter cuts drops by 75% and still reaches 91.5%, and the policies also spin a lightbulb, handle out-of-distribution goals, and withstand perturbations.
highlights_zh: 无人类数据仿真训练+可调安全过滤器
灵巧操作安全评测平台与局限
highlights_en: Human-data-free sim training plus adjustable safety filter
Platform for dexterity safety study; sim-to-real limits

papers.title: Perceiving and Predicting Dynamic Sports: Spatiotemporal Intelligence in Vision Models for Egocentric Tennis Video
papers.abstract: Agile robots require spatiotemporal intelligence to interpret scenes, reason about interactions, and anticipate future events. Yet it remains unclear how well foundation vision models support these capabilities, particularly from a moving egocentric camera, which is a natural view for robots. To investigate this, we collect an annotated tennis dataset and train a suite of vision models on spatiotemporal tasks. Our dataset contains egocentric video synchronized with five allocentric videos, estimated global positions, labeled contact times, and annotated stroke types. We then evaluate seven prediction tasks from egocentric images: 2D ego player and 3D ball localization, future player and ball trajectories, forehand or backhand stroke anticipation, time to the next ego player ball contact, and 3D ball position at that contact. We compare image encoders, video encoders, and vision-language models with jointly trained prediction heads. The best performing models achieve mean current-frame localization errors of 0.14 m for the ego player and 0.54 m for the ball, future forecasting errors of 0.34 m for the ego player and 0.91 m for the ball over 1.1 s, and a mean contact-time prediction error of 0.14 s. Auxiliary depth information substantially improves 3D ball localization, suggesting that inferring metric depth remains a challenge. Longer image histories do not improve ball forecasting, indicating that representations exploit scene context rather than rely solely on inter-frame motion. Finally, we propose a conditional diffusion model to generate whole-body kinematic tennis motion from vision encoder predictions on egocentric video at real-time rates, adapting movements as predictions are refined. These results move towards a deeper understanding of how foundation vision models can support real-time dynamic robots using egocentric video.
papers.summary_zh: 研究探究基础视觉模型能否从移动的第一人称视角支持机器人的时空理解，但这一能力尚不明确。作者构建了带标注的第一人称网球数据集（含同步多视角、全局位置、触球时间与击球类型），训练并比较图像编码器、视频编码器和视觉语言模型完成七项预测任务，并提出条件扩散模型从视觉预测生成全身网球运动。最佳模型实现自我球员0.14米、球0.54米的定位误差，1.1秒内轨迹预测误差分别为0.34米和0.91米，触球时间误差0.14秒，且深度辅助显著提升3D球定位，表明基础模型可支撑实时动态机器人。
papers.summary_en: It remains unclear how well foundation vision models support spatiotemporal intelligence from a moving egocentric view, a natural perspective for robots. The authors collect an annotated egocentric tennis dataset with synchronized allocentric videos, global positions, contact times, and stroke labels, train and compare image encoders, video encoders, and vision-language models on seven prediction tasks, and propose a conditional diffusion model that generates whole-body tennis motion from visual predictions. Best models achieve 0.14 m ego-player and 0.54 m ball localization errors, 0.34 m and 0.91 m forecasting errors over 1.1 s, and 0.14 s contact-time error, with auxiliary depth substantially improving 3D ball localization, showing foundation models can support real-time dynamic robots.
